summary: Fruit Ninja entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Fruit Ninja

emulation.notes: Use real touch hardware for input fidelity.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current official mobile build on a touch device

primary.why: Fruit Ninja is fundamentally a touch-screen mobile arcade game, and the current official iOS/Android releases preserve the intended swipe input best. Kinect and console/PC routes are control variants rather than replacements.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current official mobile app on a touch device. Record app version, device, input method, offline/online availability, account state, and whether legacy versions or Kinect are being compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Run a short comparison only if documenting the famous Kinect control branch.
secondary.why: It changes the physical input experience and should be treated as a variant.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record app version and any retired online/account features; live mobile builds can change over time.
